name: agent-composer
description: Multi-agent orchestration MCP server. Claude orchestrates; GLM, Codex, and agy do the work.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:scripts
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:scripts && npm run schema:lint
scripts.schema:lint: ajv compile --strict=true -c ajv-formats -s composer.config.schema.json && ajv validate --strict=false -c ajv-formats -s composer.config.schema.json -d composer.config.json && ajv compile --strict=true -s plugin.schema.json && ajv validate --strict=true -s plugin.schema.json -d 'plugin/*/plugin.json'
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run schema:lint
